# ReShiki 0.15.0

This release adds enhanced stereo groups, arrows with nodes in the middle and
pictures that reopen as editable drawings, draws SVG text as outlines, and
follows RDKit 2026.09 and nazuchem 0.2.0.

- **Enhanced stereo groups:** mark stereocentres as absolute (`abs`), racemic
  (`and1`) or relative (`or1`) in the **Stereo groups** inspector. MOL and RXN
  V3000, CXSMILES, CDXML/CDX and the ChemDraw clipboard keep the groups.
- **Arrows with nodes:** **Edit points** adds nodes to an arrow, so an S-shaped
  mechanism arrow stays one arrow attached at both ends.
- **Pictures that reopen as drawings:** PNG, SVG and PDF pictures from ReShiki
  carry the drawing. Paste, drop or open one in ReShiki to edit it again.
  **Include editable drawing** controls file export.
- **SVG text as outlines:** SVG export, clipboard SVG, the agent tools, the CLI
  and the Python package draw text as outlines, so labels look the same in every
  viewer. **Keep text editable** writes live text.
- **Labels without Arial:** a bundled Arial-compatible font measures and draws
  labels where Arial is not installed.
- **More inputs import:** atoms with three or four unpaired electrons (`[C]`,
  `[CH]`), SMILES features ReShiki cannot draw, charged RXN participants, MOL
  superatom groups and undrawable atropisomer axes import, with a warning where
  something was dropped or assumed.
- **Chemistry and names:** layout, CIP labels and stereo follow RDKit
  2026.09.1, and generated names follow the IUPAC 2013 rules more closely with
  nazuchem 0.2.0.
- **Coordination:** **Join** bonds every selected donor to its nearest metal,
  and **Relaxed** chemistry checks optimize metal complexes in 3D.
- **Clipboard:** Linux **Copy** also gives SMILES text; Windows **Copy** pastes a
  picture into new Outlook and web apps, and edited Office drawings keep their
  size.
- **Python and browser:** `from_name(..., online=True)`, `with_style(...)` and
  import warnings in Python; import warnings from the browser `read` and
  `load`.

**File compatibility:** most drawings saved by 0.15.0 still use document
version 30 and open in 0.13.1 and 0.14.0. A drawing with an arrow node or a
custom crossing clearance (35), a stereo group (36) or an atom with three or
four unpaired electrons (37) needs 0.15.0, and older versions ask you to
update. Older drawings still open in 0.15.0.

**Known limits:** InChI export and naming refuse structures with stereo
groups, and canonical SMILES does not yet pick one representative for a group
([Known limits](https://reshiki.com/developer/changes-0.15/#known-limits)).

macOS release downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads
remain unsigned; Windows production signing is pending.
